description: AI translation quality check — Review a translation against its source, MQM-style: categorized errors (mistranslation, omission, addition, grammar, terminology, style, locale) with minor/major/critical severity, verified spans, suggestions and a corrected translation, plus offline checks for missing numbers, placeholders like {name} or %s, URLs and suspicious length. Returns an MQM score and PUBLISHABLE / MINOR EDITS / NEEDS REVIEW / RETRANSLATE. source= and translation= required; optional source_lang= and target_lang=. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

source.description: e.g. Hello {name}, you have 3 new messages.

name: ai_translate_quality
